newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Device sets US shutdown in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Device sets US shutdown in Dec.

text.p: Integrated Device Technology Inc said Tuesday a slowdown in sales of its static random access memory microchips will cause it to shut down U.S. operations for two weeks in late December to cut costs.
In a statement, the company said it would implement other cost-cutting measures over the next few months.
Earlier, the company reported a second-quarter loss of $0.13 per share versus a profit of $0.40 in the same period last year. Integrated Device said the loss reflected soft market conditions.
"Our book-to-bill ratio in the second quarter was less than one," it said.
